name: ff_get_metadata
title: Get Figma File Metadata
description: Get the node tree structure of a Figma file or a specific node. Returns page/frame hierarchy with IDs, names, types, and bounding boxes. Use this to discover all top-level frames before extracting individual ones.

nodeId.description: Optional node ID to scope the tree (e.g. "12:86"). Omit for full file.

depth.description: How deep into the node tree to traverse; omit for all levels. Figma sends `children: []` for nodes at the requested depth, whatever they hold.

name: ff_get_screenshot
title: Get Figma Node Screenshot
description: Capture a PNG/JPG/SVG screenshot of a specific Figma node. Returns the image as a base64-encoded image content block or a URL. Target individual top-level frames, not sections or pages.

format.description: Image format: png, jpg, svg, or pdf (default: png)

useAbsoluteBounds.description: Figma use_absolute_bounds (default: false): use the full dimensions of the node regardless of whether or not it is cropped or the space around it is empty. Use this to export text nodes without cropping.

name: ff_get_design_context
title: Get Figma Design Context
description: Extract the design context for a Figma node: layout tree, component structure, styles, text content, and design properties. This is the primary tool for understanding what a screen or component looks like and how it is structured. Prefer this over separate ff_get_screenshot + ff_get_variable_defs calls (1 call vs 2).

depth.description: How deep into the node tree to traverse; omit for all levels. Figma sends `children: []` for nodes at the requested depth, whatever they hold.

name: ff_get_variable_defs
title: Get Figma Variable Definitions
description: Read the variables of a Figma file: colors, spacing, typography, radii, and other values defined in the Variables panel. Maps to the Figma REST API /v1/files/:key/variables/local endpoint.

name: ff_whoami
title: Figma Who Am I
description: Returns the current authenticated user. Use this to verify the Figma MCP is working. Figma rate-limits it like any call (Tier 3, the least limited tier), so it can return a 429.

name: export_flutter_assets
title: Export Flutter Assets
description: Export the given Figma nodes, plus descendants that have exportSettings or a visible IMAGE fill, into the Flutter assets folders and pubspec.yaml. A node's exportSettings give its format and scale (SVG and PDF at 1x; WIDTH/HEIGHT are converted to the nearest ratio of 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4); a node without them is exported in `format` at each of devicePixelRatios.

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to export; each is exported, and so are its descendants with exportSettings or a visible IMAGE fill

projectPath.description: Path to Flutter project (stdio: defaults to the current directory; HTTP: required)

format.description: Export format for nodes without exportSettings (default: png)

devicePixelRatios.description: Device pixel ratios (1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4) to export PNG at for nodes without exportSettings (default: [2])

name: export_svg_flutter_assets
title: Export SVG Flutter Assets
description: Export Figma nodes as SVG: exactly the node IDs given, plus descendants whose exportSettings include SVG. Nothing is guessed from a node's contents; hidden nodes are skipped.

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to export as SVG; descendants with an SVG export setting are exported too

projectPath.description: Path to Flutter project (stdio: defaults to the current directory; HTTP: required)

name: analyze_figma_component
title: Analyze Figma Component
description: Analyze a Figma component or component set to extract layout, styling, and structure information for Flutter widget creation. Use analyze_frame_as_screen for top-level frames.

input.description: Figma component URL or file ID

nodeId.description: Node ID (if providing file ID separately)

userDefinedComponent.description: Treat a FRAME as a component (when designer hasn't converted to actual component yet) (default: false)

includeVariants.description: Include variant analysis for component sets (default: true)

variantSelection.description: Variant names to analyze instead of every variant of a component set

projectPath.description: Path to Flutter project for asset export (defaults to current directory)

exportAssets.description: Export descendants that have exportSettings or a visible IMAGE fill (default: true)

generateFlutterCode.description: Generate full Flutter implementation code (default: false)

devicePixelRatios.description: Device pixel ratios (1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4) to export PNG at for nodes without exportSettings (default: [2])

name: list_component_variants
title: List Component Variants
description: List the variants of a Figma component set with the variant axes and defaults Figma defines

input.description: Figma component set URL or file ID

nodeId.description: Node ID (if providing file ID separately)

name: inspect_component_structure
title: Inspect Component Structure
description: Get a quick overview of component structure, children, and nested components. Use inspect_frame_structure for top-level frames.

input.description: Figma component URL or file ID

nodeId.description: Node ID (if providing file ID separately)

userDefinedComponent.description: Treat a FRAME as a component (when designer hasn't converted to actual component yet) (default: false)

showAllChildren.description: Include hidden child layers (Figma visible: false) and empty slots (default: false)

name: generate_flutter_implementation
title: Generate Flutter Implementation
description: Generate complete Flutter widget code for one Figma node, with the style definitions it uses

input.description: Figma node URL or file ID

nodeId.description: Node ID (if providing file ID separately)

includeStyleDefinitions.description: Include style definitions in output (default: true)

name: analyze_frame_as_screen
title: Analyze Frame as Screen
description: Analyze a Figma frame treated as a screen to extract layout, child layers, and structure information for Flutter screen implementation

input.description: Figma frame URL or file ID

nodeId.description: Node ID (if providing file ID separately)

extractAssets.description: Export descendants that have exportSettings or a visible IMAGE fill (default: true)

projectPath.description: Path to Flutter project for asset export (defaults to current directory)

devicePixelRatios.description: Device pixel ratios (1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4) to export PNG at for nodes without exportSettings (default: [2])

name: inspect_frame_structure
title: Inspect Frame Structure
description: Get a quick overview of a frame's structure and child layers

input.description: Figma frame URL or file ID

nodeId.description: Node ID (if providing file ID separately)

showAllChildren.description: Include hidden child layers (Figma visible: false) and empty slots (default: false)

name: extract_theme_colors
title: Extract Theme Colors from Frame
description: Extract colors from a Figma frame of color samples with labels

nodeId.description: Node ID of the frame of color samples

projectPath.description: Path to Flutter project (stdio: defaults to the current directory; HTTP: required)

generateThemeData.description: Generate Flutter ThemeData class (defaults to false)

name: inspect_color_frame
title: Inspect Color Frame
description: Inspect the structure of a frame of color samples to understand its contents before extraction

name: extract_theme_typography
title: Extract Theme Typography from Frame
description: Extract typography styles from a Figma frame of text samples with different styles

nodeId.description: Node ID of the frame of text samples

projectPath.description: Path to Flutter project (stdio: defaults to the current directory; HTTP: required)

generateTextTheme.description: Generate Flutter TextTheme class (defaults to false)

name: inspect_text_style_frame
title: Inspect Text Style Frame
description: Inspect the structure of a frame of text samples to understand its text contents before extraction

name: generate_golden_file_test
title: Generate Golden File Test
description: Generate a golden file test for a Flutter widget (testWidgets + matchesGoldenFile). Does not render, compare, or run anything itself — run `flutter test --update-goldens` once to create the reference image, then `flutter test` on later runs to check against it.

widgetName.description: Name of the Flutter widget class to test (e.g. ContinueButton)

widgetImportPath.description: Import path relative to lib/, e.g. 'widgets/continue_button.dart'

projectPath.description: Path to Flutter project (stdio: defaults to the current directory; HTTP: required)
